subject: general
question: Mohak starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 11 km, turns left and drives 15 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given:**

→ Mohak starts from Point A

→ 12 km south

→ Left turn, 11 km

→ Left turn, 15 km

→ Left turn, 14 km

→ Left turn, 3 km to Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b606080caafce71a7db82c82dc95da2a4d5ccefc9448661beae3f61ee0e0f89a.png] 

**Vertical movement:**

→ South = 12 + 3 = 15 km

→ North = 15 km

Vertical position becomes 0.

**Horizontal movement:**

→ East = 11 km

→ West = 14 km

Net movement = 3 km west.

So, Point P is 3 km west of Point A.

To reach Point A again, Mohak should travel **3 km towards the east**.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
